summary: Iter 69 Stripe verification robustness tested end-to-end. Unit suite (mocked Stripe) 10/10 pass, extended by testing agent with 7 edge cases (deposit x2 partial->paid, registering state, error->recovered open allows repay, expired not blocking, migration when quotation reflects amount, webhook retries paid+unapplied, executive verify credits once + 404) -> 17/17 pass. E2E against public URL with REAL invalid Stripe key rk_test_invalid000 on demo tenant: 10/10 API tests pass (public unresolved=verification_error, payment-status state verification_error, checkout 409 'No vuelvas a pagar' + folio, token-mismatch 404, verify-stripe readable error 'La llave de Stripe es inválida o fue revocada.', auth 401/403 & unknown/other-tenant 404, fake webhook paid payload NOT credited + 200, unknown session 200 + WARNING, mark-paid works, paid quotation checkout 400 'ya está pagada' also after regenerating public link). Backend log WARNING 'stripe get_checkout_status failed ... session_id, quotation_id, key_type=rk_, exc=CheckoutError' present for all sources; full key never logged (Stripe masks it). UI: /q/{token} shows payment-message data-state=verification_error with folio, payment-buttons/pay-total-btn hidden, verify-payment-btn visible; ?session_id saved to localStorage routiq:last-session:{token}, URL cleaned, after reload verify-payment-btn still visible and click calls GET payment-status/{sid}. Executive /app/quotations/{id}: stripe-verify-btn lists stripe-txn-{sid} with Local Pendiente, Stripe —, $1,055 (base $1,000 + comisión $55), stripe-txn-error-{sid} with readable invalid-key message. Regression iter67+iter68: 36/36 pass; 40 existing quotations detail+public open without error. Company stripe restored ($unset secret_key; now {enabled:false, publishable_key:''}) and TEST data deleted.

minor.issue: Lock release in finally sets checkout_lock_at=None unconditionally; if a request takes >30s and a second request grabs the stale lock, the first request releases the second's lock. Consider releasing only if checkout_lock_at equals the value it set.

If the old session was completed between reconcile and expire, expire fails and the code reuses the old (completed) session URL instead of re-verifying; no double charge, but client lands on a finished Stripe page. Consider re-verifying the session when expire fails.
Reconciles with Stripe synchronously on every public view (up to 50 unresolved txns sequentially) -> added latency per page load; acceptable now, consider limiting.

issues: 'Pagar por transferencia bancaria' button remains visible while the message says 'No vuelvas a pagar' – could invite a double payment by transfer
Footer 'Pago seguro procesado por Stripe' still shown when the card button is hidden
Hint 'El cliente debe aceptar la cotización antes de habilitar el pago' shown even when payment_enabled is already true (API allows enabling before acceptance)
Registrar pago date field uses native browser date picker (pre-existing)

action_items: Optional: hide/disable bank-transfer option (or add warning) while payment.unresolved is set
Optional: make checkout lock release conditional on own lock timestamp
Optional: re-verify old session when Stripe expire fails before reusing its URL
critical_code_review_comments: Single paid criterion (payment_status=='paid') consistently applied in classify/verify_session; credited_sessions guard makes apply idempotent (verified with concurrent reconciles and repeated webhooks/status calls)
public_payments.py is 678 lines – near the 700-line split threshold
PublicQuotation.jsx is 588 lines; payBlocked also depends on stale payMsg state (after a blocking message, buttons stay hidden until another message replaces it) – acceptable but note

context_for_next_testing_agent: E2E flow: `cd /app/backend/tests && python it69_e2e_setup.py setup` (sets invalid rk_ key on demo tenant, creates TEST-IT69 quotation, writes /tmp/it69_state.json), run `pytest tests/test_iteration69_e2e_api.py -k 'not test_10'`, do UI checks on /q/{token}, then test_10 (marks paid), then `python it69_e2e_setup.py teardown` (restores by $unset stripe.secret_key since demo had none).
